# AwesomeCUA curated catalog

> All 2,170 curated, source-reviewed records of the AwesomeCUA computer-use agent catalog, one compact entry each, grouped by kind. Snapshot 2026-11-06T17:14:14Z. Metadata-only bibliography records and unreviewed candidates are excluded.

Each entry links its catalog page. Append `index.md` to that URL for the full annotation with evidence fingerprints, or `record.json` for the complete record. Full annotations by kind: [Models and checkpoints](https://awesomecua.com/categories/model/index.md), [Datasets](https://awesomecua.com/categories/dataset/index.md), [Benchmarks](https://awesomecua.com/categories/benchmark/index.md), [Agents](https://awesomecua.com/categories/agent/index.md), [Frameworks](https://awesomecua.com/categories/framework/index.md), [Infrastructure](https://awesomecua.com/categories/infrastructure/index.md), [Tools](https://awesomecua.com/categories/tool/index.md), [Products](https://awesomecua.com/categories/product/index.md), [Publishers](https://awesomecua.com/categories/company/index.md), [Learning resources](https://awesomecua.com/categories/learning/index.md), [Surveys](https://awesomecua.com/categories/survey/index.md), [Research library](https://awesomecua.com/papers/index.md).

Reviews are AI-assisted inspections of primary sources. Code, data, weights and document licenses are recorded separately.

Related reading: [English research survey](https://awesomecua.com/survey/). This working manuscript uses its own frozen inventory; its text is separate from the catalog annotations below.

## Models and checkpoints (98)

### AgentCPM-GUI

8B on-device smartphone agent built on MiniCPM-V that operates Chinese and English apps from screenshots, trained with reinforcement fine-tuning and a compact JSON action space.

- https://awesomecua.com/resources/github-openbmb-agentcpm-gui/ · source: https://github.com/OpenBMB/AgentCPM-GUI
- Model · reviewed 2026-10-16 · environments: android · topics: grounding, mobile-navigation
- Licenses: code Apache-2.0
